messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike (streaming) detected in prod around 2026-03-15T09:58Z. Auto-triage started, paging on-call.

alex: ack, I'm on it. grabbing traces and checking deployments.

mira: seeing a huge collapse in prefix cache hit rate for namespace `kv-prefix` - went from ~95% -> ~9% starting 09:56Z. timing matches prefix-hash v4 rollout at 09:40Z. keys remapped.

tai: v4 introduced a different salt schedule and changed the high-to-low bit mixing. looks like no migration fallback was enabled. that would cause clients to miss existing cache entries.

sam: streaming metrics: p95 from 160ms -> 900ms, p99 to 3.9s. stream stalls and replaying fetches increased backend load and caused paging from disk on some nodes.

ops-bot: Customer impact: 22 customers saw degraded performance, 7 reported session rebuffering. Most affected regions: us-west-2.

mira: proposed live mitigations:
1) immediately pause / roll back prefix-hash v4 canary
2) enable read-dual-mode (read v4 then v3 fallback) for frontends
3) schedule targeted hotkey warmup and increase cache TTL temporarily for hot shards
4) if pressure persists, scale dedicated serving pool by +2 nodes

alex: rolling back canary now. command used: ```infra/deploy rollback prefix-hash:v4 --scope=canary```.

oncall-bot: Rollback action started by alex at 2026-03-15T10:01:12Z.

ryan: product note - affected customers got initial pings; CS drafting follow-up with guidance to pin to dedicated pools if they need stability.

sam: initiating warmup after rollback completes: ```./scripts/warmup_keys.sh kv-prefix /tmp/hot_keys_15m.txt 1200```.

mira: enabling temporary monitoring panels: prefix-hit% by region/shard, streaming p95/p99, backend fetch rate. adding alert if prefix-hit < 50% for 5m.

tai: dev note: the change that caused the remapping was a minor refactor in bucket index xor. we need a migration plan; rolling forward without dual-read is unsafe.

alex: rollback finished at 2026-03-15T10:09:45Z. immediate improvement: prefix hit climbed to 61%, p95 dropped to ~220ms, p99 ~720ms.

sam: warmup ramped to 1200rps at 10:10Z. expecting hotkey hit rates to exceed 85% in ~10-15 minutes.

mira: mitigation status: rollback ✅, dual-read toggled on as defensive, warmup in progress. still watching tail spikes during heavy backfills.

alex: summary for handoff: primary cause was prefix-hash v4 canary remapping keys -> mass cache misses -> paging/backfills -> streaming tail path saturation. mitigation: roll back canary, dual-read fallback, warmup, added alerts.

sam: lowering severity to P2 and handing off monitoring to night oncall. will follow up with a blameless RCA.

mira: action items (tickets created):
- INF-4601: RCA and migration strategy for prefix-hash v4 (owner: tai)
- INF-4602: add multi-version read checks to rollout CI (owner: eng-runtime)
- INF-4603: automated cache warmup tooling for canary rollouts
- INF-4604: dashboard and alerting adjustments for prefix-hit anomalies

customer-success: CS will consolidate impacted customers list and coordinate postmortem outreach.

alex: please do not re-deploy prefix-hash v4 until INF-4601 cleared. add gating to canary pipeline.

sam: drafting a short postmortem and linking these tickets. will monitor for 2 hours, then handoff to oncall rotation.

mira: thanks all. closing the live incident channel but keeping this thread open for postmortem comments. :white_check_mark:
